full_judgment: 2. The defendant Nos. 1 and 2 contested the suit contending that the suit was barred by limitation and also barred by provision of res-judicata. They further contended that though the suit land was recorded in the name of Nabai Biswas in Khatian No. 50 but his father Darshan Biswas was the original owner of the said land who died leaving his son Nabai Biswas and daughter Mandu Bibi. The rent receiving interest of the property, in question, was acquired by Ramani Kanta from Hare Krishna and others who instituted Certificate Case Nos. 95/1937-38 and took over possession of the suit land. Ahad Mondal and Kali Bibi took settlement from Ramani Kanta. Kali Bibi died leaving three sons the plaintiff Nos. 1 and 2 and Nasoruddin, predecessor-in-interest of the plaintiff Nos. 3-6. Ahad Mondal died leaving his wife Kumari Bibi, son Kamor Uddin and daughters Safura and Jahura. Kamar Uddin died leaving his mother Kumari Bibi, two sisters Safura and Jahura and two cousins Jobed Ali and Hosen Ali. Jobed Ali died leaving his brother Hosen Ali. Kumari Bibi herself and on behalf of her two minors daughters sold their shares to the defendant Nos. 1 and 2 by sale deed dated 08.05.1950. The plaintiff Nos. 1 and 2 and Nasoruddin took patta settlement from Safura and Jahura on 29.03.1952. Safura and Jahura, after attaining majority transferred their shares to Ekar Uddin Biswas and Rabbani Mondal by a deed dated 24.02.1956 who transferred the said land to defendant Nos. 1 and 2 by the deed dated 26.06.1957 and 04.05.1960. The defendant Nos. 1 and 2 have been possessing the suit land.
